findings.description: The wrapper now calls stats.clear() on a single dict shared by every invocation of the decorated function, instead of giving each call its own statistics dict. Concurrent calls from different threads then wipe each other's in-flight statistics.
findings.rationale: Trigger: two threads call the same @retry-decorated function at the same time. Mechanism: the second call's stats.clear() on line 377 resets the dict that the first call is still updating, and both calls write into that one dict. Impact: the statistics that wrapped_f.statistics reports for either call are wrong or incomplete, which the original rebinding avoided.
